page_title: HAM 3-2 UNI | Hamburger SV v Union Berlin 14/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Florian Badstubner has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Florian Badstubner shows a yellow card to William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) for his blatant foul.
90+5' The attendance for today's match is 57000.

90+4' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Florian Badstubner with no other option than to blow for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' 3 - 2 Goal! Oliver Burke finds Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) with a headed pass and the latter glances a header past the goalkeeper to make it 3:2.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daniel Elfadli (Hamburger) replaces Nicolas Capaldo.
87' Substitution. Ransford Konigsdorffer walks off the pitch and William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) comes on as a substitute.
86' Hamburger SV failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
83' Steffen Baumgart has decided to make a change. Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) replaces Stanley Nsoki.
83' Substitution. Aljoscha Kemlein is replaced by Andras Schafer (Union Berlin).

82' 3 - 1 Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Frederik Ronnow is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 3:1.
77' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) takes a snap shot on the edge of the box, but it sails well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
77' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 10:9.
75' Substitution. Alex Kral (Union Berlin) on for Rani Khedira.
74' Bakery Jatta will be replaced by Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger).
72' Merlin Polzin decides to make a substitution. Philip Otele will be replaced by Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger).
72' Substitution. Robert Glatzel will be replaced by Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger).
71' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) unleashes a brilliant effort from the free kick, but the ball crashes against the bar. What a chance!
70' Dangerous play by Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger). Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul. Union Berlin have a free kick from a promising distance.
67' Union Berlin enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
64' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florian Badstubner had an easy-decision to make.
64' Chance! Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.
63' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes is prepared to thwart his effort.
61' Here is a change. Woo-Yeong Jeong is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Livan Burcu (Union Berlin).
61' We are about to witness a substitution. Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) is replacing Ilyas Ansah.

59' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
57' Hamburger SV take a short corner kick.
55' The Hamburger SV players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
52' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Union Berlin.
51' The free kick from long range, taken by Union Berlin, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
50' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) has tested the patience of referee Florian Badstubner and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
47' Florian Badstubner blows for a foul after Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' 2 - 1 Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!
45+2' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
42' Great teamplay by Hamburger SV as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

39' The ball rebounds out to Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.
38' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Union Berlin, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

35' 1 - 1 Goal! Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) takes a short pass from Robert Glatzel in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
33' Wonderful movement by Hamburger SV. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
30' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
28' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Daniel Heuer Fernandes no chance!
27' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
26' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Florian Badstubner blows for a foul. The referee makes the call - penalty to Union Berlin!
24' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
22' Union Berlin seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
20' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
19' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) commits a foul during an attacking move.
18' Hamburger SV take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
17' The resulting set piece from Hamburger SV is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Hamburger SV manage to earn a corner.

13' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.

12' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) produces a header from inside the penalty area, but he doesn't manage to hit the ball properly and it flies well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
9' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
6' The Hamburger SV players are exchanging some short passes.
4' A lofted pass finds Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
4' A quickly taken corner by Hamburger SV.

3' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Hamburger SV have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
3' Hamburger SV work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
3' He should have scored! Bakery Jatta (Hamburger) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Hamburger SV will take a corner kick.
2' The corner is swung in but Union Berlin can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
1' The first half has just begun.
Union Berlin will kick the game off.
Florian Badstubner will supervise the game today.
